rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the punctuation mark.

example.english: Please write the answer after the colon.
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 mou6 hou6 hau6 min6 se2 daap3 on3

rows.note: Use this for the anatomical part of the large intestine, especially in medical contexts.

example.english: The doctor said my colon is slightly inflamed.
example.traditional: 醫生話我個結腸有少少發炎。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ngo5 go3 git3 coeng4 jau5 siu2 siu2 faat3 jim4
